clauses.title: Consistent supplier identity
clauses.text: The legal vendor name on the company profile, commercial offer, insurance certificate, and security attestation must match. A conflicting supplier identity requires clarification.

clauses.title: Tax registration
clauses.text: The supplier company profile must provide a tax registration identifier in the format NN-NNNNNNN. Missing or malformed tax registration requires clarification.

clauses.title: Insurance evidence
clauses.text: Liability insurance coverage must be at least USD 1,000,000 and the certificate must not expire before the review date. Expired coverage or an insufficient liability limit requires clarification.

clauses.title: Commercial budget
clauses.text: The total quoted price of the commercial offer must not exceed USD 100,000. An offer above the budget requires clarification.

clauses.title: Required submission documents
clauses.text: Every submission must include one company profile, one commercial offer, one insurance certificate, and one security attestation. Missing documents, duplicate document types, unsupported files, or unverifiable fields require manual clarification.

clauses.title: Data handling controls
clauses.text: The security attestation must confirm encryption at rest and data retention of no more than 30 days. Missing encryption or longer retention requires clarification.
